words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْفَكُ}} ({{tr:yuʾfaku}}) opens the ayah as an ongoing passive: someone is being made to turn away, but the agent is not named. The Form IV and away-from frame make the movement induced and directional, while {{ar:أ ف ك}} ({{tr:ʾ-f-k}}) keeps the act from sounding like neutral redirection; it carries inversion, falsehood, and corrupted reception. Variant-agency contrasts can make the liar or already-turned person active, but this local surface keeps the cause hidden. Because the subject is delayed, the reader first meets the condition itself, and the later audible same-root close turns that opening process into a ring in which present diversion is explained by a prior completed state.

topics.headline: opening ongoing passive diversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin with an ongoing induced turning-away whose agent is withheld, so diagnosis comes before blame assignment.
topics.reason: The local verb is imperfect passive Form IV; attachment evidence leaves its agent unexpressed, so the opening presents continuing caused diversion without naming the cause.

topics.headline: turning away through a separation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is completed by an away-from phrase, making the event directional rather than a simple transitive manipulation.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement is syntactically forced and selects separation; broader root branches remain pressure but the local frame is turning away from a referent.

topics.headline: root field of inversion and falsehood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not hear neutral redirection: the root field makes the turning cognitive, moral, and tied to false speech, with overturned-city imagery in the background (53:53; 69:9).
topics.reason: No V4 dictionary rows are available for this root, so the supplied CRITICAL lexical pressure is retained but narrowed to color the local separation sense rather than replacing it.

topics.headline: variant readings expose alternate agency models
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that accepted and apparatus contrasts can make the liar or the already-turned person active, while the local surface keeps both agency and cause grammatically hidden.
topics.reason: The local canonical form remains passive, so active or intensified variant models are useful contrasts but do not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: verb-first diagnosis before the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences diversion before knowing who bears it, and the prior direct address is recast as a third-person diagnostic class.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes the passive predicate precede its subject phrase; this supports the CRITICAL claim that condition and direction arrive before the affected class is revealed.

topics.headline: opening root returns as audible frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening root return at the close, so the four-word ayah becomes an audible loop of ongoing process answered by completed state.
topics.reason: The opening and closing verbs share the same root and passive voice while differing in aspect and form; the sound rows are retained as local recitational payoff tied to that frame.

words.gloss_range: from it or away from it, with the suffix referent intentionally recoverable only from prior discourse
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهُ}} ({{tr:ʿanhu}}) compresses separation and reference into one bound phrase. It does not name the agent of the passive verb; it marks the source or object from which the subject is turned away, while the suffix keeps that referent suspended across the boundary with the previous discourse. The phrase also shifts from direct address into third-person reference and can shade the distance as a disturbed relation to disputed speech, though its local role remains separation. Its placement before the subject makes the reader feel distance first and identification second, and the sound of the phrase also leads directly into the delayed class marker.

topics.headline: ambiguous suffix binds the clause backward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader has to recover what the suffix points to from the prior discourse, so the four-word ayah remains tied to the preceding promise, judgment, and disputed speech.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix antecedent ambiguous and instructs preserving that ambiguity, so the CRITICAL backward-link payoff is locally licensed.

topics.headline: preposition marks source of turning away
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the phrase marks what one is turned away from, not who does the turning.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is the complement of the passive verb and the translation support explicitly warns against reading it as the passive agent.

topics.headline: separation phrase precedes the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters unresolved distance before the affected person is named, so referent-loss and subject-delay work together.
topics.reason: Local word order places this phrase between the opening passive and the relative subject, matching the CRITICAL claim that separation is foregrounded before identification.

topics.headline: separation can shade into relation to speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear distance from the referent together with a disturbed relation to the preceding speech, while the local role remains separation.
topics.reason: The local grammar selects an away-from complement; the topical or concerning shade survives only as discourse pressure from the preceding speech context.

topics.headline: nasal echo links separation to the delayed class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the separation phrase flow into the following class marker, so the recitation surface binds distance and identification.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and concrete, and it supports the structural move from separation phrase to delayed subject rather than inventing a new semantic claim.

words.gloss_range: the one who or whoever, locally functioning as a headless relative subject with a generalizing edge
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) finally supplies the subject, but it does so as a free relative: not a named person, but the class defined by the closing passive. The local syntax supports a relative subject, while the surface still lets the statement feel general: whoever fits the prior turning is the one now being turned away. After the suspended away-from phrase, this word pivots the ayah from unresolved separation into a closed diagnostic identity, with a nasal bridge that lets the class marker grow audibly out of the separation phrase. It also turns direct confrontation into open classification, ready for the next ayah's named condemnation (51:10).

topics.headline: delayed free relative supplies the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader discovers that the subject is not a simple named person but a compact whoever-clause defined by the final passive.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as the headless relative subject phrase of the opening passive, and its delay after the verb and prepositional phrase is locally visible.

topics.headline: relative identity and conditional generality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear both class-identification and whoever-like generality, even though the local syntactic analysis treats the phrase as a free relative subject.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support the headless relative parse; the conditional force is therefore narrowed to a generalizing reading effect rather than a replacement of local syntax.

topics.headline: pivot from suspended referent to closed diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the suspended away-from phrase turn immediately into a definition: the one being turned away is whoever has already been turned.
topics.reason: There is no conjunction between the first beat and the identifying phrase, so the delayed subject and final predicate close the diagnosis rather than adding a loose explanation.

topics.headline: direct address becomes an open class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches the prior you-address recede into an impersonal class, which can then be named more concretely in the following condemnation (51:10).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary rows cohere with the third-person free-relative form; the forward bridge is retained with the concrete next-ayah reference (51:10).

topics.headline: nasal hinge from separation to closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the class marker grow out of the preceding separation phrase before the final passive closes the statement.
topics.reason: The phonetic claim is limited to the local recitation sequence and supports the transition from separation phrase to subject phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:أُفِكَ}} ({{tr:ʾufika}}) gives the withheld definition: the person now turned away is the one who has already been turned. The perfect passive makes the prior state completed, while the passive voice again leaves the cause unnamed. Through {{ar:أ ف ك}} ({{tr:ʾ-f-k}}), that state is not neutral confusion but settled inversion with falsehood and overturning pressure; variant readings can expose active lying or straying as contrasts, but the local word remains passive. As the final word, it answers the opening process with a rare completed form and a clipped same-root echo, so the ayah closes where it began but now as verdict.

topics.headline: completed passive state explains present diversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reaches the cause-like condition at the end: the one now being diverted is defined by a prior completed turning.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect passive and its subject is controlled by the preceding relative, so the final word states completed affectedness without naming an agent.

topics.headline: relative predicate defines the person by affectedness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that identity is built from being affected, while the cause of that prior turning remains grammatically hidden.
topics.reason: The relative clause has no overt object or agent; attachment evidence says the passive agent remains unresolved and the subject is syntactically controlled by the relative.

topics.headline: settled inversion carries falsehood valence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not end on mere misdirection; the completed state is morally and cognitively inverted, with false speech and overturning pressure retained as root-family coloring.
topics.reason: Because no V4 root rows are available, the CRITICAL lexical field is retained as pressure on the local completed passive state, not as separate active fabrication by the subject.

topics.headline: variant readings test patient and liar agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how alternate readings can turn the defined person into an active liar or intransitive strayer, while the local canonical form keeps the final word passive.
topics.reason: The canonical local word is passive; active, intransitive, or intensive variants are therefore contrastive apparatus rather than the governing parse.

topics.headline: rare perfect passive marks the endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah chooses the rare completed passive exactly where it defines the diverted class.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks this perfect passive as low-occurrence and the only local exact-form instance, supporting the CRITICAL rarity payoff without making rarity itself a new sense.

topics.headline: final verb closes the opening loop
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final verb answer the opening verb: the present process is enclosed by the completed condition that explains it.
topics.reason: The word is final, shares root and passive voice with the opener, and differs by aspect; the ring and echo rows converge on closure rather than decorative repetition.

topics.headline: short final sound shuts the ayah down
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same compact root path return in a clipped final form, making completion audible as well as grammatical.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are retained because they point to the local final articulation and cadence that accompany the grammatical closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same passive root occurs at words 1 and 4 around the relational phrase at words 2-3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled passive makes diversion recursive: the person selected by the second turning is the one already characterized by turning. The sentence therefore presents orientation as a self-reinforcing condition while withholding both the agent and the antecedent of the pronoun.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing away from its direction supplies both the repeated motion and the recursive selection rule.

changed_reading.before: A person simply rejects an unnamed claim.
changed_reading.after: Only one already set into a turned orientation is further turned from it; rejection is staged as an enacted trajectory rather than a bare conclusion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two passive forms of the same root allow the root's falsehood sense to describe both what happens and what has formed the person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Falsehood is not only an alternative proposition. Because it is itself speech bent away from truth, it can operate as the medium that bends its bearer, making content and causal process coincide.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood as speech diverted from truth lets bent content become the instrument that diverts its bearer.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified force causes someone to believe a lie.
changed_reading.after: The lie's own bent form becomes a habitat and causal medium: one is turned by becoming formed through turned speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both verbs are passive, and the second describes the selected person as already affected before the first predicate completes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction foregrounds prior deformation of judgment or strategy rather than a fully intact chooser making one isolated refusal. It leaves open whether that deformation is self-produced, socially induced, or externally imposed.

activation_trace.role: A diverted mind or frustrated stratagem makes impaired orientation the condition under which the further turning occurs.

changed_reading.before: The passive merely omits the persuader.
changed_reading.after: The passive exposes damaged epistemic capacity: the apparent choice arrives after judgment or strategy has already been rerouted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies dispersal, load-bearing transport, flow, and apportionment. Activated against the wind branch of the focus root, the focus becomes the human sorting point of a larger transport process: trajectories do not merely wander but arrive at different allotments.

activation_trace.role: Winds that vary or leave their courses literalize the repeated passive as directional deflection.
Wind-driven winnowing supplies the dispersive first movement of the process.
Bearing a visible load makes the motion transport consequential content rather than drift empty.
Flowing onward supplies the continuous course from which deflection can be measured.
Separating shares turns divergent movement into an allotting or sorting operation.

structural_cues: The four opening clauses progress with linked particles from dispersal through transport and flow to distribution.
In 51:9, the preposition marks departure from a course while the relative subject selects the affected person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four ordered motions and a wind-like focus branch; I infer that they form a process chain whose human-scale sorting point is 51:9. A live alternative is that the opening images remain parallel oaths and do not causally feed the focus.

changed_reading.before: Diversion is an isolated mistake inside one person's mind.
changed_reading.after: Diversion is a sorting event within a loaded flow: a person exits one course as trajectories are dispersed and allotted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised matter is presented as fulfilled and fixed, while the audience is located inside speech whose members take different paths. The woven-path cue makes those sayings more than opinions: they become structured routes. The focus root's falsehood branch then names how an inhabited discourse turns its own inhabitant.

activation_trace.role: Bent speech supplies the causal medium by which a bearer is bent away from truth.
Fulfillment of promise moves truth from verbal assertion toward realized action.
Falling and becoming fixed gives the promised matter event-like solidity.
Tightly wrought paths provide a spatial analogue for structured routes of discourse.
Speech as belief or doctrine makes the enclosing saying a lived orientation.
Each party taking a different road converts disagreement into path divergence.

structural_cues: 51:8 places the audience inside differing speech immediately before the doubled passive of 51:9.
The sequence contrasts realized promise with plural verbal routes rather than merely contrasting two propositions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed fulfillment, wrought paths, and residence inside divergent speech; I infer that discourse can route its inhabitant and thus cause the focus diversion. The live alternative is a simple contrast in which speech evidences diversion but does not produce it.

changed_reading.before: A person independently chooses a false proposition over a true one.
changed_reading.after: A person inhabits a divergent speech-route that recursively carries its speaker away; discourse is both the symptom and machinery of turning.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, enveloping heedlessness becomes questioning about timing, then the delayed object returns as assay and tasted experience. Diversion therefore acquires a temporal mechanism: displaced judgment buys apparent distance, but the object of evasion reappears as an embodied test.

activation_trace.role: A diverted mind or frustrated strategy supplies the attempted cognitive escape from what is coming.
An enveloping film of falsehood or ignorance supplies the medium that hides the event.
Heedlessness stabilizes the concealment as a condition of the heart.
Assaying metal or a person turns the evaded claim into a test that exposes quality.
Experiential tasting replaces distant speculation with direct encounter.
Hastening supplies the temporal pressure that makes postponing disbelief recoil into immediacy.

structural_cues: 51:12 asks when, and 51:13-14 answer with a day and an imperative of tasting.
51:10 names conjecturers immediately after the focus, but its uncued root is used only as structural placement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, heedlessness, temporal questioning, assay, tasting, and haste; I infer a reversal from deferred cognition to forced experience. A live alternative is that the later scene is only consequence, not the return of the same diverted epistemic process.

changed_reading.before: Diversion is a static state of mistaken belief.
changed_reading.after: Diversion is temporal evasion: it pushes an event away in thought until that event returns as an assay that must be tasted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Springs, taking, giving, and deprivation activate the focus root's rain-withheld land image. The passive person can be modeled as a failed receiving site within a gift circuit: what should arrive, be taken up, and fruit is deflected, while successful recipients continue the circuit toward the deprived.

activation_trace.role: Land from which rain is diverted makes non-reception and failed fruiting a material model for the passive person.
A flowing spring supplies the water source that a receptive site can receive.
Taking possession models successful uptake rather than mere exposure.
Giving establishes the inbound movement that reception completes.
Deprivation names the blocked endpoint and extends reception failure into an ethical relation.

structural_cues: The post-assay contrast moves to gardens and springs, then to receiving a gift and recognizing the deprived within one's possessions.
Both focus verbs remain passive, so the text does not reduce failed reception to a transparent single cause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water, reception, gift, and deprivation; I infer a circulation in which received good should fruit and pass onward, with focus diversion as blockage. A live alternative is that these are contrasting destinies without a shared transfer mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse diagnoses only an intellectual refusal.
changed_reading.after: The verse can diagnose a blocked capacity to receive and transmit: the person resembles a site from which life-bearing input has been diverted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence relocates evidence from earth to the observers' own selves and finally to their act of speaking. The focus mind is therefore not empty of evidence but turned away from what is already immediate; diverted attention fails to convert visible sign, inward self-presence, and speaking indication into settled recognition.

activation_trace.role: A diverted mind makes misorientation of an existing faculty, rather than absence of evidence, the focus mechanism.
A manifest sign supplies evidence placed openly before attention.
The thing's own self relocates evidence inside the observer rather than at a remote object.
Insight of the heart makes the challenged failure one of inward discernment, not eyesight alone.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the stable object from which attention is deflected.
Speaking as an indicating act makes the audience's own performance part of the available evidence.

structural_cues: 51:20-23 moves through earth, selves, sky, and the audience's own speech.
The interrogative in 51:21 challenges non-seeing even though the evidence is located within the addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest signs, self-presence, inward sight, fixed reality, and indicative speech; I infer that the focus turning reroutes attention away from already immediate evidence. A live alternative is that the final speech comparison intensifies certainty without making speaking evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: The affected person lacks enough evidence or intellectual power.
changed_reading.after: The affected person has evidence at earth, self, and tongue, but attention has been rerouted so that immediacy does not become recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats a person grammatically as a trajectory inside an atmospheric topology. It remains anchored in the focus root's differing-winds branch, the preposition of departure, and packet-backed scattering, woven paths, and divergent roads. Downstream prose should present it as a material-spatial analogy, not as a lexical replacement for ordinary human diversion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled passive root and the departure preposition can stage two changes of course around the selected person.

activation_trace.role: Variable wind courses make the selected person readable as a repeatedly deflected trajectory.
Wind-winnowing supplies particles whose destinations depend on moving currents.
Wrought broken paths provide the topology through which the trajectory moves.
Different parties taking different roads transfers atmospheric divergence into human orientation.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels a person who holds the wrong view.
changed_reading.after: The verse briefly images a person as mobile matter sorted by intersecting currents and paths, with differing speech functioning like directional shear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it carries the rain-withheld-land image into a statement about a person. It remains valid as an analogy because the packet surrounds the focus with fertile earth, springs, rain-provision, and deprivation. Downstream prose should retain causal uncertainty and must not claim that the focus lexically means rainfall.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive selected person can analogically occupy the focus root's position of land from which rain and growth have been turned.

activation_trace.role: Rain-deprived land supplies the focus analogy of a receptive surface left unfruited.
A flowing source shows the contrasting condition in which water reaches and sustains a site.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receptive ground on which signs can become growth.
Rain descending as provision locates the life-bearing input above the still-unreceptive site.
Deprivation keeps open the possibility that non-reception names loss as well as culpable refusal.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is entirely an internally authored act of rejection.
changed_reading.after: Turning away can also be carried as a rain-shadow condition: provision is present, but the person-site remains deprived of reception and fruiting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it makes the addressee's counter-speech perform evidence against its own diversion. It remains anchored in falsehood as bent speech, residence inside differing discourse, and speech as an indicating act compared with fixed reality. Downstream prose should call this a performative activation of the sequence, not insist that the comparison's sole function is self-refutation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The falsehood branch of the repeated focus root permits speech to be both the turned content and the act that turns the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Bent speech binds the speaker's utterance to the mechanism of the speaker's own diversion.
Speech as doctrine makes the counterclaim an inhabited commitment rather than a passing sound.
Fixed correspondence to reality supplies the standard that bent speech fails to displace.
Speech as indication lets the act of voicing divergence simultaneously display the immediacy used to affirm reality.

changed_reading.before: Divergent speech merely reports a prior false belief.
changed_reading.after: The speaker's divergent utterance both continues the turning and performs the very faculty invoked as an indication of the reality being resisted.

strongest_changes: The immediate move from being inside divergent speech to the doubled passive turns discourse from a symptom into a plausible routing mechanism.
The opening chain of scattering, carrying, flowing, and apportioning activates a spatial sorting model alongside the epistemic one.
The earth-self-sky-speech sequence revises compromised capacity into redirected attention away from evidence already present in the observer and the observer's speech.
Springs, giving and taking, deprivation, fertile earth, and rain-provision keep alive a reception ecology in which diversion is blockage as well as rejection.
summary.what_was_special: The two passive occurrences of one root form a recursive hinge. Around that hinge, material flows and speech acts repeatedly exchange roles, allowing directional, discursive, cognitive, temporal, and receptive readings to coexist without collapsing into one cause.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only antecedent of the pronoun remains unstated, so promised event, fixed truth, discourse-route, and provision-like input remain competing referents.
The passive construction does not settle whether the turning is self-conditioned, socially induced, externally imposed, or distributed across those causes.
The wind and rain models are strongly packet-activated but remain material analogies rather than secure lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Diversion recursively reproduces diversion.** Both verbs are anchored in `ء ف ك/B001`, turning from a proper direction. Their passive repetition, following divergent speech in 51:8, creates a feedback structure. The packet supplies repetition; I infer **prior turning -> further turning from the referent**. The line reads as self-propagating displacement rather than a single mistaken conclusion.
2. **Falsehood as the turning instrument.** `ء ف ك/B002` supplies a lie diverted from truth. Later formulaic accusations in 51:39 and 52 provide the speech mechanism. I infer **false attribution -> attention redirected away**. This retains a distinct linguistic cause alongside the spatial turning image.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The repeated “magician or madman” labels in 51:39 and 52 supplied the missing instrument of diversion: false categorization turns attention away.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Recursive deflection.** **Lexical evidence:** both fixed verbs repeat `ء ف ك/B001`, “turning something away from its proper direction.” **Structural cue:** the preceding doctrinal pathways differ (51:8); the two passive forms surround the relative subject, and the following ayat move through conjectural measure, engulfing haze, displaced questioning, and assay (51:10–14). **Role and abduction:** the first passive marks diversion from the referent and the second characterizes a person already diverted; I infer a feedback loop in which prior misorientation makes further redirection possible. **Reading change:** the compact line reads as a self-reinforcing topology of error, not simply a one-time act of persuasion.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:10–14 revealed the loop’s end-state: conjecture and haze persist until assay supplies a forced directional correction through experience.

The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
